title: 1.3 Functions
description: Definition of a function and the vertical line test

questions.question: Any set of ordered pairs is called a:
A relation in which every first component is related to only one corresponding second component is called a:
A relation $R$ is a function if whenever $(x,y)\in R$ and $(x,z)\in R$, then:
For the relation $R=\{(-1,0),(0,-3),(2,-3),(3,0),(4,5)\}$, which statement is correct?
options: $R$ is a function because each first component is paired with exactly one second component
$R$ is not a function because $-3$ appears twice in the range
$R$ is not a function because $0$ appears twice in the domain
$R$ is not a function because it contains the negative number $-1$
questions.correctAnswer: $R$ is a function because each first component is paired with exactly one second component

questions.question: The relation $R=\{(6,1),(7,3),(0,2),(6,4)\}$ is not a function because:
options: the first component $6$ is paired with two different second components $1$ and $4$
the first component $7$ is paired with $3$
the second component $2$ appears only once
questions.correctAnswer: the first component $6$ is paired with two different second components $1$ and $4$

questions.question: The relation $R=\{(x,y):y=x+1\}$ is a function because:
options: for any given $x$ there is only one $y=x+1$
it contains infinitely many ordered pairs
the graph is a straight line
it has no repeated first components
questions.correctAnswer: for any given $x$ there is only one $y=x+1$

questions.question: The relation $R=\{(x,y):x^{2}-y^{2}=0\}$ is not a function because:
options: it contains no ordered pairs with $x=0$
the equation $x^{2}-y^{2}=0$ has no real solutions

questions.question: Which of the following relations is a function?
The Vertical Line Test says that a set of points in the coordinate plane represents a function exactly when:
options: every vertical line meets the graph in at most one point
every horizontal line meets the graph in exactly one point
every vertical line meets the graph in at least two points
the graph passes through the origin
questions.correctAnswer: every vertical line meets the graph in at most one point

questions.question: For the relation $R=\{(x,y):y=3x+1\}$, which statement is correct?
options: $R$ is a function because for each $x$ there is exactly one value $y=3x+1$
$R$ is not a function because $y$ can be negative
$R$ is not a function because it is a linear relation
$R$ is a function because its graph passes through two axes
questions.correctAnswer: $R$ is a function because for each $x$ there is exactly one value $y=3x+1$

questions.question: The relation $R=\{(x,y):x^{2}+y^{2}=9\}$ is not a function because:
options: its graph is a circle, so the vertical line $x=0$ meets it at $(0,3)$ and $(0,-3)$
its graph is a circle, so the horizontal line $y=0$ meets it at $(3,0)$ and $(-3,0)$
the number $9$ is a perfect square
the graph passes through the origin
questions.correctAnswer: its graph is a circle, so the vertical line $x=0$ meets it at $(0,3)$ and $(0,-3)$
